rules.title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance - Annual Rent Cap
rules.requirement: Increases in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance, effective November 19, 2021
rules.quoted_span: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental property located in Santa Ana, CA, that does not fall within exemptions
rules.exemptions: Buildings with certificate of occupancy on or after February 1, 1995; mobile home spaces offered for rent on or after January 1, 1990

rules.title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance - Relief Petition Mechanism
rules.requirement: Any owner of residential rental property or a mobile home park may petition for relief from the cap by providing evidence that a rate increase in excess of the annual allowance is necessary to provide a fair and reasonable return for their property. The City Manager, or designee, may consider a variety of relevant factors and will decide on the petition within 60 days of receiving a complete application.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance, effective November 19, 2021

rules.title: Just Cause Eviction Ordinance - Primary Requirement
rules.requirement: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance, effective November 19, 2021
rules.quoted_span: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.

rule.title: Just Cause Eviction Ordinance - At-Fault Causes
rule.requirement: "Just cause" includes certain at-fault causes such as default in payment of rent, breach of a material term of the lease, committing a nuisance, criminal activity, and other actions.

rule.title: Just Cause Eviction Ordinance - Notice and Cure Requirement
rule.requirement: Before issuing a notice to terminate for just cause, the owner shall first give notice of the violation with a time period for the tenant to fix the violation(s).
rule.citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance, effective November 19, 2021
rule.quoted_span: Before issuing a notice to terminate for just cause, the owner shall first give notice of the violation with a time period for the tenant to fix the violation(s).

rule.title: Just Cause Eviction Ordinance - No-Fault Relocation Assistance
rule.requirement: Under a no-fault just cause termination, the owner shall either provide 3 months of relocation assistance or waive payment of rent for the final 3 months of the tenancy.
rule.citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance, effective November 19, 2021
